children.help_text: Module height, vertical alignment, and spacing. Height cascades from XL unless overridden; vertical alignment defaults to middle with per-breakpoint overrides.

children.name: spacing

children.help_text: Adjust margins and padding for the module wrapper. Margin creates space between modules; padding creates space around the module content. When no padding is set, use no padding (do not default to 25px). When the module has multiple spacing fields (e.g. Text Box Padding), each applies to its intended target only — see MODULE-SETTINGS-BACKGROUND-STANDARD §1.

children.name: enable_card_as_link
children.label: Enable Card as Link
children.help_text: When on, the entire card is clickable (uses the card button link). When off, only the button links. Only applies to cards that have a button with a link.

children.name: slider_settings
children.label: Slider settings
children.help_text: Use as slider when cards exceed cards per row. Configure arrows, dots, autoplay, and bounce.

children.name: use_slider_when_overflow
children.label: Use As Slider
children.help_text: When there are more cards than the number per row, show a slider instead of wrapping to the next row. When off, cards wrap as before.

children.name: show_slider_arrows
children.label: Show slider arrows
children.help_text: Show previous/next arrows on the left and right of the slider. Only applies when the slider is active.

children.name: custom_arrows
children.label: Custom arrows
children.help_text: Customize the left and right slider arrows. Use Font Awesome icons (default) or upload images. Size affects both arrows equally. Arrows sit at the slider edges; use Module spacing (padding) to add more or less space around the module if needed.

children.name: arrow_size
children.label: Arrow size
children.help_text: Size of both left and right arrows (px).

children.name: left_arrow_type
children.label: Left arrow
children.help_text: Font Awesome icon or image upload for the previous (left) arrow.

children.name: left_arrow_image
children.label: Left arrow image
children.help_text: Upload PNG, SVG, or other image for the previous (left) arrow.

children.name: right_arrow_type
children.label: Right arrow
children.help_text: Font Awesome icon or image upload for the next (right) arrow.

children.name: right_arrow_image
children.label: Right arrow image
children.help_text: Upload PNG, SVG, or other image for the next (right) arrow.

children.name: arrow_color_choice
children.label: Arrow color
children.help_text: Color for Font Awesome arrows. Only applies when an arrow uses Font Awesome.

children.name: arrow_hover_color_choice
children.label: Arrow hover color
children.help_text: Color when hovering over Font Awesome arrows. Only applies when an arrow uses Font Awesome.

children.name: show_slider_dots
children.label: Show slider dots
children.help_text: Show pagination dots below the slider. Only applies when the slider is active.

children.name: custom_slider_dots
children.label: Custom Slider Dots
children.help_text: Customize the active and inactive dot colors. Only applies when Show slider dots is on.

children.name: slider_dots_active_color
children.label: Active color
children.help_text: Color of the active slide indicator.

children.name: slider_dots_inactive_color
children.label: Inactive color
children.help_text: Color of the inactive slide indicators.

children.name: slider_autoplay
children.label: Auto advance slides
children.help_text: When on, the slider advances to the next slide automatically. Only applies when the slider is active.

children.name: slider_smooth_scroll
children.label: Smooth scroll
children.help_text: When on, the slide transition uses the full seconds-between-slides duration for a smooth scroll instead of a quick jump. Hidden when Continuous scroll is on. Only applies when Auto advance slides is on.

children.name: slider_continuous_scroll
children.label: Continuous scroll
children.help_text: When on, the slider scrolls continuously without stopping. Uses seconds-between-slides to control pacing. Hides arrows and dots. Only applies when Auto advance slides is on.

children.name: slider_bounce
children.label: Slide bounce
children.help_text: When auto-advance is off, a subtle bounce hints that more slides exist. Uses the seconds-between-slides value for frequency. Only applies when Auto advance slides is off.

children.name: slider_autoplay_interval
children.label: Seconds between slides
children.help_text: When auto-advancing: seconds before next slide. When slide bounce is on: seconds between bounce hints.

name: cta_buttons
label: Buttons
help_text: Add one or more buttons below the cards. Use Button Alignment for horizontal alignment.

children.name: alignment
children.label: Button Alignment
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment of the buttons (left, center, or right).

children.name: horizontal_align_md_override
children.label: Override Button Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: horizontal_align_md
children.label: Button Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Alignment when Override Button Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: horizontal_align_sm_override
children.label: Override Button Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: horizontal_align_sm
children.label: Button Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Alignment when Override Button Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: add_button_1
children.label: Add Button 1 (legacy)
children.help_text: Legacy field. Used when Buttons repeater is empty. Data preserved from older module versions.

children.name: button_1_arrow
children.label: Button 1 Arrow (legacy)
children.help_text: Legacy: Add arrow to button. Maps to Add Icon in new Buttons repeater.

children.name: add_button_2
children.label: Add Button 2 (legacy)
children.help_text: Legacy field. Used when Buttons repeater is empty.

children.name: button_2_arrow
children.label: Button 2 Arrow (legacy)
children.help_text: Legacy: Add arrow to button. Maps to Add Icon in new Buttons repeater.

children.name: cta_button_items
children.label: Buttons
children.help_text: Add one or more buttons.

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video. Requires Marketing Video in your HubSpot account.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop. Works on all HubSpot tiers (no Video Management required).

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources. For autoplay as background, use a URL that includes autoplay and muted if supported.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.
